part_note: Part A: stub loader + _stub_committed_configs.json + placeholder tau/R are ALLOWED and recorded in the ledger (loader/configs/R/Sigma source fields). Part B sets part = B: the real loader, committed_configs.json, landing_R.json, ercot_noise_exact_cov.csv and E-D7 are then ASSERTED at init.
objectives_note: contract section 3 JSON order (V < E < X < R < N); E1 pending the plan section 1.2 verdict (E3 if not READABLE); R4 / N1 PROVISIONAL (E-D1b, PI). The list is read from this file; the ledger header flags the provisional seats.
acq_seed_rule: acq_seed_base + 100 * seed_id + k; torch.manual_seed(s) once per process before sampler construction and optimisation; the tau RNG default_rng(20261006) is numpy and distinct. Reuse of the RTS integers on a different X/Y is statistically harmless.
n0_tier_source: committed_configs.json["E-D7_decided"] (32 or 48); the nav prefix of n0_E by sobol_index

qnehvi.ref_point: R from landing_R.json restricted to `objectives` (contract 6.4); negated after z-scoring (BoTorch maximizes)

gp.source: committed_configs.json objectives.<id>.cfg (D-1025 4-tuple kernel/transform/noise/prior) + .floor; refit each round on the FULL accumulated lane set
gp.train: bogp.gp_model.train_gp defaults (Adam, 700 epochs, lr 0.01), float64 SingleTaskGP per objective (ModelListGP)

R1.name: load shed (MWh)
R1.response: plan 1.3: violating run stays in the ledger, infeasible-for-claims, excluded from reported fronts and HV; from the round AFTER the first violation acquisition = constrained qNEHVI with a shed GP constraint shed <= 1 MWh (degenerate-constant shed column: feasibility = 1, recorded); >= 2 violations in one round -> HALT FOR DECISION

R2.name: reserve shortfall (MWh)
R2.response: round flag if any run > 2 x base; recorded; never halts; no acquisition role

suspect.rule: plan 1.2 S1-S3 per run from pool_row (meta.suspect); a SUSPECT run is excluded from HV and gain and flagged; >= 2 SUSPECT in one round -> HALT FOR DECISION; the cost objective is never switched mid-campaign

calibration.C1: ingest fail-stop: all q runs present (v3 identity), objectives finite, SUSPECT check, shed check

C2.rule: covered <= 4 of 8 for any objective (95 percent total band of the pre-round GP)

C3.rule: >= 3 of 8 points with |z| > 3 for any objective

budget_option: C (plan section 8; E-D4 default): 1 arm x 5 seeds x cap 4 x q 8 = 160 BO runs. B = add a qparego arm with seed_ids [0, 1]; D = seed_ids 0-4 on both arms and hard_cap 6 (one edit each).
